1.consolidated_definition: Tranquear, dar trancos o pasos largos el caballo. “Soy como un potro/ que se comienza a montal,/ que aunque sea de buena casta/lo que jase es tranguleay.” Alonso.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To trot or give long strides to a horse. "I am like a young colt that is being mounted, / although it may be of good breed, / what it says is tranguley." Alonso.
